title: Chapter 39 The Ruined Camp
content:
Chapter 39 The Ruined Camp

At this critical moment, Wang Shuo took out a "random teleportation scroll".

In an instant, Wang Shuo was teleported to another strange place.

At this time, the system prompt sounded:

[Ancient battlefield, exploration completed 1%, the ancient battlefield map is open. 】

Isn't it the "void battlefield"?

How did it become the "ancient battlefield"?

Wang Shuo was a little puzzled, and turned to the map page, and found that a new page was created on the map page.

There was a large area on it, and he was still a small green dot. What made Wang Shuo happy was that the map marked the safe area and the dangerous area.

At this moment, Wang Shuo was already at the edge of the safe area.

"I don't know how far the random distance is this time, it only reaches 1% of the map."

After carefully observing the map, the safe area of the entire map is very small, and the dangerous area is displayed in red, and there are more dangerous areas, which can be said to be red and purple.

The name of the safe area is "the ruined camp".

Wang Shuo thought silently and decided to take a look at this so-called camp first.

After comparing the direction, he walked towards the ruined camp.

Not long after setting off, Wang Shuo saw a human skeleton in the distance, rushing towards him quickly.

Use the "Eye of Delusion" to take a look.

[Skeleton Soldier]

[Level: Level 3]

[Attack Power: 24]

[Defense Power: 5]

[Health Value: 750]

[Skills: None]

[Evaluation: The most common first-level undead soldier in the ancient battlefield, there is no soldier more rubbish than it! ]

Wang Shuo looked at his naked equipment attributes.

[ID: 5678 Wang Shuo]

[Level: Level 5]

[Strength: 10]

[Constitution: 15]

[Agility: 10]

[Energy: 17]

[Health Value: 650]

[Defense Power: 0]

If there is no equipment, his attack power: 10; defense: 0; health value: 650.

Wang Shuo silently shed tears. At this moment, he only wanted to say to the skeleton soldier: "Brother Skeleton, I'm sorry for you. I stole your title."

He also wanted to say to Lord Zach: "Lord Zach, you are really wrong this time."

I can't beat the ghost myself, can I not beat even the worst skeleton soldier?

In order to express respect for the skeleton soldier and test his own strength at the same time.

He decided to have a fair duel with the skeleton soldier.

Of course, in order to be fair, he still summoned his gold medal fighter, the golden armor warrior, from his backpack as a referee.

If the skeleton soldier could think and speak, he would definitely say "tui, shameless" at this time.

The movement speed of the skeleton soldier is obviously much slower than Wang Shuo, about half of that of a normal person.

At this time, Wang Shuo's movement speed is already twice that of a normal person, so there is almost no suspense in this battle.

Wang Shuo took out an iron axe from his backpack. His excellent quality spear was damaged, so he could only make do with it at this moment.

Seeing the skeleton holding a bone knife and taking staggering steps, Wang Shuo kicked it directly.

As expected, the bones scattered all over the ground did not appear. The skeleton soldier just took a few steps back.

"Hey, this skeleton is pretty solid." Wang Shuo began to take it seriously. He held the axe with both hands and smashed the skull of the skeleton soldier hard.

With a "bang", a gap was cut in the skull of the skeleton soldier, and Wang Shuo's knuckles were also shocked!

[Your attack caused 20 points of damage to the skeleton soldier. ]

Fortunately, since Wang Shuo's agility was much higher than that of the skeleton soldier, he could basically effectively avoid or resist the attack of the skeleton soldier.

In less than a minute, the skeleton soldier finally turned into a pile of bones, and also dropped an energy crystal.

Wang Shuo understood that he had a chance to obtain a large number of energy crystals again.

Just after killing the skeleton soldiers, another skeleton soldier approached from a distance. Wang Shuo said nothing and directly struck him with an axe.

At this time, with an equally matched opponent as a sparring partner, Wang Shuo decided to practice his fighting ability.

But he had not yet practiced martial arts, so he was a little unsystematic in fighting.

Two hours later, there were finally no skeleton soldiers around Wang Shuo who could stand!

He continued to head towards the ruined camp.

I don't know how far I will go. The distance on the map is 10 centimeters, and the actual distance cannot be estimated.

Until the evening, the distance on the map was less than 1/3, which made Wang Shuo despair.

I should not have come in earlier. He regretted it now.

In order to get to the camp as soon as possible, Wang Shuo handed over the skeleton soldiers he met along the way to the golden armor warriors.

If he kept rushing here, he would waste time in vain. When the 8 days were up, he would definitely be surpassed by other players. In this knockout match, he might really be eliminated.

"Ah!"

He sighed deeply. In the Gobi Desert, the temperature difference between day and night is very large. The temperature at this time is close to zero degrees. Wang Shuo lit a fire on the spot.

He took out food and water and gave some to Da Huang.

Looking up, Wang Shuo felt a little heavy at the desolate scene around him.

After eating the dry food, Da Huang, who was lying next to the fire, cried again.

Wang Shuo looked around quickly and found that there were more skeleton soldiers approaching in the distance.

Is it over yet?

Looking closely, this time there was a group of skeleton soldiers, and the one leading was obviously much taller.

Wang Shuo investigated and found that it was a Skeleton King.

[Skeleton King]

[Level: Level 10]

[Attack: 200]

[Defense: 20]

[Health: 1800]

[Skill: Strong Attack]

There was also a small boss, and Wang Shuo wanted to practice his skills, but there were still a dozen skeleton soldiers around, which made it a bit tricky.

Wang Shuo quickly ordered the golden armored warrior to take action and clear the skeleton soldiers first, and he also went up to avoid the Skeleton King and began to clear the surrounding skeleton soldiers.

Due to the golden armored warrior, the Skeleton King was only left with half of his health soon.

Wang Shuo decided to fight again. The Skeleton King's attack was very high. As long as he was attacked 3 times, Wang Shuo would be in danger.

Therefore, he had to deal with it carefully.

The bone knife and the battle axe collided, splashing sparks. Wang Shuo chopped on the skeleton king's skeleton several times, but did not directly cut the bones.

The physical strength of the skeleton king is more than a little stronger than that of the skeleton soldiers.

Fortunately, the golden armored warrior had cut a crack on the bones of the skeleton king's arm before. Wang Shuo attacked the same place as much as possible. After fighting for 10 minutes, he finally cut off his right arm.

There was no suspense in the next battle. After another 5 minutes, Wang Shuo killed the skeleton king.

Every monster here also has an ID, which Wang Shuo is no longer surprised. Moreover, Wang Shuo can choose to turn off certain information in the system prompt.

At this time, the system prompt sounded:

[You killed the skeleton king and upgraded to level 6. The reward can be allocated 1 free attribute point. ]

Since Wang Shuo has not yet figured out how to allocate free attribute points, there are already 5 attribute points that can be allocated.

After a night's rest, he continued on the next day.

The closer they got to the camp, the fewer skeleton soldiers there were, and Wang Shuo traveled faster and faster.

Finally, on the morning of the third day, Wang Shuo arrived at the camp.
